implementation_directions: Single change: create surfaces/feedback-rounds/spec.md (mode=create).
Frontmatter matches existing FNSR spec convention (recon identifies). Include: document_kind: fnsr-protocol-spec; spec_number: 08; version: 0.1; status: draft (or as recon recommends).
Document sections (recon may suggest adjustments):
- Purpose: why feedback rounds need a protocol distinct from retro and Pass 2a
- Phases (8 phases per the protocol gap analysis):
1. Capture (verbatim collection; analog: retro gathering)
2. Atomic Decomposition (split bundled feedback into single-claim items; MUST happen BEFORE bundling)
3. Categorize + Scope (per atomic item: classification + effort)

4. Completeness Map (per atomic item: which canonical artifacts must be updated — SPEC sections, FRs, ROADMAP, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN, source modules, spec tests, Playwright tests, demo materials, walkthrough docs)
5. Adjudication (operator decides per-atomic-item: ratify / amend / defer)
6. Implementation (chain dispatch per ratified atomic item)
7. Reconciliation (verify each atomic item's completeness map was fully landed — analog of the missed step that caused Item J's provision-half to be lost)
8. Phase-Close Consumption (update canonical docs; archive deferred items as forward-tracks; surface deltas in retrospective)

- Agent roles: which agents in each phase; reconnaissance + developer + architect for the main chain; new role candidate 'feedback-decomposer' for Phase 2 + 'feedback-reconciler' for Phase 7 (or these can be modes of existing agents)
- State persistence: feedback-rounds/<round-id>/STATE.jsonld with chain-hashed audit per existing surface conventions
- Audit event shapes: feedback_round_initiated, atomic_item_decomposed, item_adjudicated, item_implemented, item_reconciled, feedback_round_closed
- Operator commands: state_admin feedback-round init / decompose / adjudicate / reconcile / close (analog of retro family)
- Integration with forward-tracks (Spec 07): each non-ratified atomic item becomes a forward-track in state-A
- Integration with phase-boundary (Spec 07): feedback round can be tied to a phase-close; reconciliation prevents phase from closing if items have unfinished completeness maps
- Anti-patterns / failure modes (empirical evidence from demo/FEEDBACK.md round):
- Premature bundling (Item J: prevention + provision bundled as one; lost provision)
- Lost completeness map (no record of which artifacts need updating per item)
- No reconciliation pass (no agent verifying every item's map was honored)
- Manual-only triage (no atomic-decomposition step; recon agent bundles based on intuition)
- Empirical-evidence appendix: cite demo/FEEDBACK.md Item J + OPERATOR-MEDIATION-LOG.md Event 9 + 12 as the empirical motivation
v1 status: draft. The spec is the PROTOCOL specification; implementation is downstream substrate work (new agents, state_admin commands, daemon hooks)
